trigger.raw_text: The operator logs into the RLCS application software.

claims.content: If the operator is not logged in, the system shall request user name and corresponding password. If authorization fails, command control is denied.
If a device status has been overridden, it shall appear with a different color from the normal and alarm status colors.
For alarm status, the GUI shall issue an audible alarm, and the icon shall be different from the okay status for that device. The visual alarm shall include a change of color for the affected device.
The operator has successfully viewed the current status of all field devices and system components via the Graphical User Interface (GUI).
All device statuses are accurately displayed using dynamic icons, with appropriate color coding to indicate normal, alarm, or overridden states.
Any active alarms have been visually and audibly presented to the operator, including a change in icon color for affected devices.
The system continues to update device status information every 2 seconds while the operator remains logged in.
If applicable, the operator has acknowledged any audible alarms, silencing them for a configurable duration or permanently for specific devices.
